fix_subject: Fix the CSV invalid UTF-8 error for projected columns, and compare extra values with the NULL string by length
pr_title: Merge #26594: Fix the CSV invalid UTF-8 error for projected columns, and compare extra values with the NULL string by length

labels.summary: The CSV invalid UTF-8 error path used the column's file index instead of its projected chunk index, causing an internal error when only some columns were read, and strict-mode extra values that were a prefix of the NULL string were wrongly accepted as NULL because lengths were not compared.
